descriptionChirho: Compound proper name פַּחַת מוֹאָב ('governor of Moab'), designating a post-exilic Judean clan or its ancestral head. The name appears in returnee lists (Ezra 2:6, 8:4, 10:30; Neh 3:11, 7:11, 10:15). The two sense clusters represent the two morphological halves of a single compound name: פַּחַת (eng: Pachat, arb: فَحَتِ, swa: Pahathi) and מוֹאָב (eng: Moab, spa: Moab, hin: पहत–मोआब, swa: Moabu). These are not independent senses but inseparable parts of one proper noun.
